user_sees: Every word, figure and button of the journey in full
must_not: Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other

steps.action: The member sends the question to Rahul
user_sees: Nothing yet on Rahul's side
must_not: The question refused because the alert failed

steps.action: Rahul's admin app rings
user_sees: Asha sent you a question. Open Member messages to reply.
must_not: The question text in the alert

steps.action: Tap the alert
user_sees: Member messages (/member-messages)
must_not: Another trainer or the desk getting this alert
The owner's bell ringing for it
Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other

note: Trainers use phones on the floor
